short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Volt's circuit voltage overshoots and bounces before settling.
With an inductor and a capacitor, energy swings between them. Too little resistance, and it rings. Just right, and it settles fast.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Overdamped, critically damped or underdamped. Car suspensions use the same idea.
